case_name: Management of Madurantakam Co-Operative Sugar v S. Viswanathan
respondent:
S. Viswanathan
Supreme Court of India

22 February 2005
Appeal (Civil)  2619 of 2003
The Judgment was delivered by : N. Santosh Hegde, J.
1.  In this appeal the appellant is challenging an order made by the Division Bench of the High Court of Judicature at Madras which allowed a writ appeal filed by the respondent-workman (the workman) reversing the order of the learned Single Judge of the same court who in turn had set aside the award of reinstatement made by the Labour Court.
2.  The respondent was working as a Clerk in the Divisional Office of the appellant Sugar Mills which had several godowns in different places under the control of the said Divisional Office. The appellant Sugar Mills used to issue permit for supply of manure in bags to cane growers. holding: The direction of the tribunal granting full back wages may be modified, and the respondent-workman will be entitled to 50% of the back wages in addition to all other retiral benefits as if he was in service throughout the period when his services were discharged.
